data_policy: Generate a disposable database, documents, code, OpenAPI and loopback target. Never import workspace user data or credentials.

cases.title: Route a request to the selected specialist
steps: Submit an automatic agent task with a scripted performance route
expected: Exactly one routing and one specialist response are consumed

cases.title: Observe, generate and execute UI automation
steps: Observe the generated local page with Chromium
Execute the final stored browser case
expected: Exactly one PASS result and real trace exist
Context manifest refers to this task

cases.title: Generate a source-grounded manual test case
steps: Submit test-case generation using generated portal requirements
expected: One case is persisted with the real generated source ID
Manual draft is not marked runnable

cases.title: Build automation for a selected manual case
steps: Select the generated manual refresh case
Observe the page and build executable actions
expected: Original case ID and expected result remain

cases.title: Review selected cases with validated evidence
steps: Submit case_review with a generated case ID

cases.title: Execute saved API cases without an AI account
steps: Select a newly generated GET /health case
expected: No AI resolution or model call occurs

cases.title: Repair a stale locator while preserving the oracle
steps: Use the generated real browser run that failed on obsolete-status
Repair and execute the same case
expected: Original case ID and Healthy expectation remain
Final browser run passes with trace

cases.title: Analyze generated repository source
steps: Submit repo_under against generated discount code

cases.title: Produce a downloadable report for a real run
steps: Select the generated failed browser run
expected: Report contains the selected run ID

cases.title: Analyze generated requirements
steps: Submit requirement_under with generated requirement evidence
expected: Correct specialist persists an analysis finding

cases.title: Create an evidence-backed test plan
steps: Submit test_plan using generated portal requirements

cases.title: Generate reviewable unit-test code
steps: Submit unit_test with generated discount source
expected: One source-grounded unit case is stored
Generated code has valid Python syntax

cases.title: Generate and execute an API test
steps: Submit api_test using the generated health contract
Execute against the loopback HTTP server
expected: Generated case retains valid source grounding
Real GET /health run completes with PASS

cases.title: Analyze a real failed fixture run
steps: Select the generated failed browser run

cases.title: Assess regression from generated source changes
steps: Submit regression against generated discount source

cases.title: Produce a performance analysis
steps: Submit performance with generated portal evidence

cases.title: Produce a security analysis
steps: Submit security with generated portal evidence

cases.title: Produce an exploratory testing charter
steps: Submit exploratory with generated portal evidence

cases.title: Design test data from generated evidence
Reject execution of a manual-only case
steps: Create a new case with no execution engine

cases.title: Reject a cross-origin API case
steps: Create a new request to outside.invalid

cases.title: Reject a selected case from another project
steps: Request case review there using the original fixture project case
expected: No task or model call is created

cases.title: Report an actual HTTP assertion failure
steps: Create a case expecting 201 from the generated /health endpoint that returns 200
expected: PASS count is zero and FAIL count is one

cases.title: Do not execute a completed run twice
steps: Deliver the same run ID again while guarding against another HTTP execution

cases.title: Reject invalid model output without storing cases
steps: Supply a scripted invalid generation response with no cases and an unknown field
expected: Task is FAILED with an error

cases.title: Generate a ready UI draft without a final run
steps: Submit UI automation in generate mode
expected: Task is READY with one executable draft

cases.title: Request missing source before specialist dispatch
expected: Task is NEEDS_INPUT with a reason
Only the routing response is consumed

cases.title: Upload and retrieve a generated requirement
steps: Generate an invoice-limit document in memory
expected: Search returns the uploaded source and exact 37-items oracle

cases.title: Index a newly generated repository ZIP
steps: Generate a ZIP containing one Python module in memory
expected: HTTP 201 with exactly one imported file
Generated function is indexed as code

cases.title: Index a newly generated OpenAPI contract
steps: Generate a health OpenAPI document in memory
expected: Indexed contract contains /health and its 200 response

cases.title: Agent skill registry responds successfully
Missing task returns 404 while demo expects 200
steps: GET an absent generated task ID
expected: Assertion fails with actual HTTP 404; report shows FAIL

cases.title: Refreshed UI shows Healthy while demo expects Offline
expected: Assertion fails with actual Healthy; report shows FAIL with browser evidence

cases.title: Temporary HTTP 503 recovers on retry
steps: Request the controlled fixture endpoint with the attempt index
expected: First attempt FAIL and retry PASS; report shows FLAKY

cases.title: UI readiness recovers on retry
steps: Inject generated Starting status on the first attempt and Healthy on retry
expected: First attempt FAIL and retry PASS with the same oracle; report shows FLAKY

cases.title: Live provider credentials are unavailable in the demo
steps: Declare a runtime skip with the missing demo credentials reason
expected: Report shows SKIP and the reason; no live provider request

cases.title: Production mutation is outside the demo scope
steps: Declare a runtime skip with the excluded production scope reason
expected: Report shows SKIP and the reason; no production mutation
